units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Gratitude. It is fortunate that the sum of our knowledge has been preserved, even in the most remote depths of space."|369|0
units.english: "Gratitude. It is fortunate that the sum of our knowledge has been preserved, even in the most remote depths of space."
units.italian: "Gratitudine. È una fortuna che la somma del nostro sapere sia stata conservata, persino nei recessi più remoti dello spazio."

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Frustation. Energy shields should not work in the way they do. They make no sense!"|370|0
units.english: "Frustation. Energy shields should not work in the way they do. They make no sense!"
units.italian: "Frustrazione. Gli scudi energetici non dovrebbero funzionare come funzionano. Non hanno alcun senso!"

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Frustation. Even now, decades after we invented the hyperdrive, only a small group of experts can truly claim to understand the way it works."|371|0
units.english: "Frustation. Even now, decades after we invented the hyperdrive, only a small group of experts can truly claim to understand the way it works."
units.italian: "Frustrazione. Ancora oggi, decenni dopo che abbiamo inventato l'iperpropulsore, solo un piccolo gruppo di esperti può davvero dire di capire come funziona."

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Pride. I did my thesis on a new type of solar cell junction. Now I see them on half the ships in the sky!"|372|0
units.english: "Pride. I did my thesis on a new type of solar cell junction. Now I see them on half the ships in the sky!"
units.italian: "Orgoglio. Ho fatto la tesi su un nuovo tipo di giunzione per celle solari. Ora le vedo su metà delle navi in volo!"

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Amusement. You always see bright up-and-coming students claim to have invented a new kind of faster than light drive. Eighty years ago, one of them was actually right!"|373|0
units.english: "Amusement. You always see bright up-and-coming students claim to have invented a new kind of faster than light drive. Eighty years ago, one of them was actually right!"
units.italian: "Divertimento. Si vedono sempre studenti brillanti e promettenti sostenere di aver inventato un nuovo tipo di motore più veloce della luce. Ottant'anni fa uno di loro aveva davvero ragione!"

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Curiosity. It's a wonder that once wormholes were considered the most likely option for traveling faster than light. I wonder how the hyperdrive was invented first?"|374|0
units.english: "Curiosity. It's a wonder that once wormholes were considered the most likely option for traveling faster than light. I wonder how the hyperdrive was invented first?"
units.italian: "Curiosità. È sorprendente che un tempo i wormhole fossero considerati l'opzione più probabile per viaggiare più veloce della luce. Chissà come mai l'iperpropulsore è stato inventato prima?"

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Information. Our engineers created a type of coating that can greatly reduce a ship's atmospheric drag by causing shed vortices to destructively interfere with each other."|375|0
units.english: "Information. Our engineers created a type of coating that can greatly reduce a ship's atmospheric drag by causing shed vortices to destructively interfere with each other."
units.italian: "Informazione. I nostri ingegneri hanno creato un tipo di rivestimento che riduce molto la resistenza aerodinamica di una nave, facendo interferire in modo distruttivo i vortici di scia tra loro."

units.id: news:avgi physicist|"Amazement. The simulations say that a memory diamond can retain its information for millions of years, if stored in stable conditions. That might outlast our entire civilization!"|376|0
units.english: "Amazement. The simulations say that a memory diamond can retain its information for millions of years, if stored in stable conditions. That might outlast our entire civilization!"
units.italian: "Stupore. Le simulazioni dicono che un diamante di memoria può conservare le sue informazioni per milioni di anni, se tenuto in condizioni stabili. Potrebbe sopravvivere a tutta la nostra civiltà!"

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Instructive. The Twilight Nebula is a reflection nebula nearly a thousand light years wide. Illuminated by relatively young neutron stars, it is the remnants of multiple supernovae that occurred millions of years ago."|394|0
units.english: "Instructive. The Twilight Nebula is a reflection nebula nearly a thousand light years wide. Illuminated by relatively young neutron stars, it is the remnants of multiple supernovae that occurred millions of years ago."
units.italian: "Istruttivo. La Twilight Nebula è una nebulosa a riflessione larga quasi mille anni luce. Illuminata da stelle di neutroni relativamente giovani, è ciò che resta di più supernove esplose milioni di anni fa."

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Inquisitive. It is notable that the star cluster southeast of Stream is mostly made up of young, hot stars. That part of the Twilight nebula was likely once a dense molecular cloud, compact enough to collapse into giant stars millions of years ago."|395|0
units.english: "Inquisitive. It is notable that the star cluster southeast of Stream is mostly made up of young, hot stars. That part of the Twilight nebula was likely once a dense molecular cloud, compact enough to collapse into giant stars millions of years ago."
units.italian: "Curioso. È notevole che l'ammasso stellare a sud-est di Stream sia fatto per lo più di stelle giovani e calde. Quella parte della Twilight Nebula era probabilmente una densa nube molecolare, abbastanza compatta da collassare in stelle giganti milioni di anni fa."

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Tutelage. The Twilight Nebula is not in hydrostatic equilibrium. It is slowly contracting as it cools, a stellar nursery on a massive scale."|396|0
units.english: "Tutelage. The Twilight Nebula is not in hydrostatic equilibrium. It is slowly contracting as it cools, a stellar nursery on a massive scale."
units.italian: "Insegnamento. La Twilight Nebula non è in equilibrio idrostatico. Si contrae lentamente mentre si raffredda: un vivaio stellare su scala enorme."

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Frustration. The galaxy is three-dimensional, but you wouldn't know it from the way everyone draws their maps!"|397|0
units.english: "Frustration. The galaxy is three-dimensional, but you wouldn't know it from the way everyone draws their maps!"
units.italian: "Frustrazione. La galassia è tridimensionale, ma non si direbbe guardando come tutti disegnano le loro mappe!"

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Annoyance. Using cardinal directions like 'North' and 'West' to describe locations in the galaxy should be a crime! Polar coordinates for 'spinward' and 'rimward' would be far better."|398|0
units.english: "Annoyance. Using cardinal directions like 'North' and 'West' to describe locations in the galaxy should be a crime! Polar coordinates for 'spinward' and 'rimward' would be far better."
units.italian: "Fastidio. Usare punti cardinali come 'Nord' e 'Ovest' per descrivere posizioni nella galassia dovrebbe essere un reato! Coordinate polari per 'senso di rotazione' e 'verso il bordo' sarebbero molto meglio."

units.id: news:avgi astronomer|"Curiosity. To this day, there is no explanation as to why some systems are linked by starways and others are not."|399|0
units.english: "Curiosity. To this day, there is no explanation as to why some systems are linked by starways and others are not."
units.italian: "Curiosità. Ancora oggi non c'è spiegazione del perché alcuni sistemi siano collegati da vie stellari e altri no."
